user_objective.interpretation: Mochipoyo reproduction is the coverage anchor. The research system may add independent alerts, provided source-alert coverage is preserved and extras are evaluated separately for net value.

required_separation.SOURCE_MATCHED: Proxy transition corresponding to a supported Mochipoyo source event.
required_separation.MISSED_SOURCE: Supported Mochipoyo source event without an accepted proxy match.
required_separation.EXTRA_CANDIDATE: Proxy transition without a source match after grace expiry; permitted but not yet proven useful.
required_separation.EXTRA_ACCEPTED: Extra candidate proven useful under strictly forward or frozen walk-forward outcome evaluation.
required_separation.EXTRA_REJECTED: Extra candidate rejected by a pre-decision-only loss-reduction rule.

post_m7c_research_sequence.purpose: Investigate missed source events and design recall-first candidate extensions without using future outcomes.
Freeze extra-signal timestamps first, then evaluate future outcomes separately with transaction costs and no lookahead.
Build and forward-test a gate that removes poor extra alerts only; do not suppress matched source alerts by default.
Compare source-anchor only versus source-anchor plus accepted extras on net profit, PF, drawdown, losing streak, and signal count.

success_metrics.prohibited_shortcut: Do not tune the extra-signal gate on the same forward sample used to claim performance.
